title: Pocketwire Advance Terms — One Line per Customer
content:
**Clause 1. One line.** A customer may hold one (1) Pocketwire Advance line.

**Clause 2. Opening a further line.** A line is opened only if the customer holds no other advance line whose status is anything other than closed.

**Clause 3. Earlier line closed after a write-off.** A customer whose earlier Pocketwire Advance line closed after a write-off can apply again only once the written-off amount has been repaid in full.

**Clause 4. Evidence.** Clause 2 is decided on the system record of the customer's advance lines: every advance line held under the same customer and the status each one shows. What the customer says about an earlier line does not replace that record.

## Status of the customer's other lines

Clause 2 turns only on the status of any other advance line of the same customer. The condition it sets reads as follows for each status a line can show.

| Status of another advance line of the customer | Clause 2 condition |
|---|---|
| applied | Not met — no line is opened |
| active | Not met — no line is opened |
| past due | Not met — no line is opened |
| suspended | Not met — no line is opened |
| closed | Met for that line |

A customer with no other advance line, or whose every other advance line is closed, meets the Clause 2 condition. Where one of those closed lines closed after a write-off, Clause 3 applies in addition: the customer can apply again only once the written-off amount has been repaid in full.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A customer whose only earlier Pocketwire Advance line is suspended asks for a new line. The earlier line's status is other than closed, so no line is opened.
- A customer whose earlier line closed after a write-off, and whose written-off amount is still partly unpaid, asks to apply again. Under Clause 3 the customer cannot apply again until that amount has been repaid in full.
